The moon is sometimes round like a white plate, sometimes curved like a little sickle. After it rains, a beautiful rainbow appears in the sky too... all of these you have yet to see."

lines.en: "Is the sky really that big? Are there really so many wondrous things out there? Could it be that I really don't know anything at all?"

simp.text: 那天晚上，呱呱躺在井壁上，看着星星，第一次睡不着觉。他开始想：也许有一天，他真的应该想办法跳出这口小井，去看看老海说的那个世界。

trad.text: 那天晚上，呱呱躺在井壁上，看著星星，第一次睡不著覺。他開始想：也許有一天，他真的應該想辦法跳出這口小井，去看看老海說的那個世界。

lines.en: That night, Gua Gua laid down looking up at the stars, and for the first time he could not fall asleep. He began to think: maybe one day, he really should find a way to leap out of this little well, and go see the world Lao Hai had spoken of.
